responsibility: Provides the target-independent OS configuration framework for LynxOS. It defines reusable extra-spec bundles and default CPP/LIB/LINK/STARTFILE/ENDFILE specs for Lynx targets, including thread and shared-library variants, default static-link behavior, Lynx-specific preprocessor macros, library selection, start/end files, standard type defaults, assembler alignment behavior, and POSIX I/O support. This header serves as the common LynxOS base that target-specific <arch>/lynx.h files can override or reuse.
same_name_distinction: Within the Lynx same-name pair, this header provides the reusable LynxOS spec framework and default CPP/LIB/LINK/STARTFILE/ENDFILE behavior, while lynx.opt only defines the target options that those specs consult.
